classification: Synthetic algorithm timings; not native UI latency; no CI timing threshold
build: Standalone Graph.cpp compiled with -std=c++20 -O2 -DNDEBUG, no sanitizer; dependencies linked from release libnemo_core.a. Same flags for both variants; saved baseline header overlay precedes src. Exact commands in benchmark.cpp.
method: Fixed two-nodes-per-layer fully reconverging DAG plus isolated node; graph construction/warm-up excluded. Five steady_clock batches, baseline 3 queries/batch, corrected 10000; report min/median/max batch-average nanoseconds/query. Final measurements after compilation completed; no CPU pinning/frequency control. Baseline tiny-query batches are clock/noise sensitive. Both query results must be false, with printed observed-answer checksum.
interpretation: root_to_isolated removes demonstrated exponential forward path enumeration. isolated_to_last deliberately exercises the reverse ancestor traversal; it costs more than the old isolated-origin early exit but stays bounded in these measured graphs. Code inserts discovered IDs before scheduling expansion; each node expands once and only via edgesInto. std::map adjacency and std::set visited lookups add logarithmic factors; not a strict linear-time claim.
